title: DOJ Says “ocsic” (Cisco Backwards) Was in Huawei's Code

lines.say: O, C, S, I, C. That is Cisco, spelled backwards. And the Justice Department says it was written in Huawei's code.
lines.show: O, C, S, I, C. That is Cisco, spelled backwards. And the Justice Department says it was written in Huawei's code.

lines.say: Prosecutors say Huawei copied Cisco router source code, which the announcement calls Cisco's crown jewel.

scene.src: U.S. Dept. of Justice press release 26-1413, Nov 24, 2026

lines.say: In an effort to hide it, the announcement says, engineers left Cisco's notes about the code behind, and called Cisco by its name backwards.

scene.src: U.S. Dept. of Justice press release 26-1413, Nov 24, 2026

lines.say: On November twenty-fourth, a federal jury in Brooklyn convicted Huawei of conspiracy to steal trade secrets.
lines.show: On November 24, a federal jury in Brooklyn convicted Huawei of conspiracy to steal trade secrets.
